mechanism: Both agents are commonly used in combination for synergistic antimicrobial coverage, but doxycycline may reduce oxacillin's bactericidal efficacy when used together due to opposing mechanisms (bacteriostatic vs bactericidal).
action: Monitor clinical response carefully; consider sequential dosing or alternative combinations if treating serious infections where synergy is critical, as the bacteriostatic effect of doxycycline may antagonize oxacillin's bactericidal activity.
